title: Observability onboarding screenshots pack — latency, cost-per-token, and trace explorer
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Produce a compact, accessible set of product screenshots and annotated assets for the onboarding/quickstart flow focused on observability. The pack should include high-fidelity images and callouts for: 1) latency timeline per model/route, 2) cost-per-token breakdown for a single session and aggregated view, and 3) trace explorer walkthrough showing request span, model fallback, and cache hit information. These will be used in the Quickstart guide, in-app tour, and release notes for console-2025.03.
acceptance_criteria: Three final PNG and SVG export assets: latency_timeline.png, token_cost_breakdown.png, trace_explorer_walkthrough.png
Each screenshot has clear callouts (arrow + 1-sentence tooltip) for the primary metric displayed
All copy passes accessibility review (contrast >= 4.5:1 and legible font size) and aligns with Quickstart voice
Annotated source Figma file with named layers and export presets provided
Product team signs off (PM review comment resolved) and assets uploaded to Drive and Console assets folder
design_notes: Aim for compact card-style screenshots that can be read in a 600px width modal
Latency timeline: use stacked area for p50/p95/p99 with a highlighted model switch marker
Cost-per-token: show per-request breakdown and an aggregated histogram for a 24h window
Trace explorer: include a mocked slow call with fallback to a cheaper model and a cache hit indicator
Use Redwood color tokens; focus state for hover and keyboard focus included in separate layers
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Martinez): Prefer explicit label 'Cost per token (USD)' rather than shorthand 'Cost' — addressed in token_cost_breakdown_v1.png
Eng (Ethan Brooks): Trace explorer example should surface request ID and span duration — added a top-left request ID in the screenshot
Accessibility (Maya Gupta): Increase text size on timeline axis and use bolder line weight for p99 — updated in Figma
Design lead (Rina Kapoor): Reduce visual noise in token cost histogram; add tooltip examples for two real request samples — in progress
next_steps: Resolve Rina's noise-reduction feedback and export final PNG/SVGs (owner: Liam Chen)
Upload final assets to Drive and attach to Quickstart PR (PR link below)
Coordinate with docs writer to update Quickstart markdown screenshots and alt text
Schedule 15m sign-off with PM and Eng for 2025-03-14 release window
